taxonomy:
Here is a simple single-depth taxonomy of the listed grid-based logic games, using 7 categories and placing each game in exactly one category.

# 1. Loop and Path Drawing
- Dotchi-Loop
- Hashiwokakero
- Masyu
- Mid-loop
- Numberlink
- Slitherlink
- Suraromu

# 2. Shading and Region Division
- Choco Banana
- Double Choco
- Five Cells
- Heyawake
- Juosan
- Kurodoko
- LITS
- Nurikabe
- Shikaku
- Tilepaint

# 3. Object Placement and Packing
- Akari
- Evolomino
- Hebi
- Makaro
- Moon-or-Sun
- Norinori
- Pencils
- Ripple Effect
- Sto-stone
- Sudoku
- Yosenabe

# 4. Number Placement and Arithmetic-Style Fill
- Fillomino
- Nansuke
- Sashigane

# 5. Direction, Connectivity, and Route Constraints
- Nagareru
- Satogaeri
- Yajilin

# 6. Black-and-White Cell Logic
- Hitori
- Kurotto
- Nurimisaki
- Nurimeizu
- Nuritwin
- Usowan

# 7. Mixed or Specialty Grid Constraints
- Chained Block
- Shakashaka
